```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r Import}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

F4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_fa_04_fratrie_04.sas7bdat")

M4_C2_bornes0 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_C2_bornes0.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```

## Corriger données d'identité

```{r F4_A0 to F4_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
F4_A1 <- F4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    pf_fratrie_prenom = str_to_upper(pf_fratrie_prenom),
    pf_fratrie_prenom = replace_when(
      pf_fratrie_prenom,
      pf_fratrie_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    ),
    pf_fratrie_prenom = str_replace(
      pf_fratrie_prenom, "É", "E")
  )

commentaires <- F4_A1 %>% 
  select(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep, commentaires_fam) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    id_og = if_else(id_anonymat == id_doublon, 0, 1)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep, id_og) %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(id_doublon)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(!is.na(commentaires_fam))) %>% 
  fill(commentaires_fam,
       .direction = "up") %>% 
  select(id_keep, commentaires_fam) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

F4_A2 <- F4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(F4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_fratrie_cat), -fratrie_type) %>% 
  rows_patch(
    commentaires,
    by = "id_keep"
  )

rm(commentaires)

```

## Garder les colonnes du module

```{r F4_A2 to F4_B0}

F4_B0 <- F4_A2 %>% 
  relocate(
    c("id_date_nais", "id_sexe", "fratrie_date_creation", "fratrie_pf_fratrie", "pf_fratrie",
      "pf_fratrie_prenom", "pf_fratrie_sexe", "pf_fratrie_mois_nais", "pf_fratrie_an_nais",
      "pf_frsr_issu", "pf_frsr_mois_adopte", "pf_frsr_an_adopte", "pf_fratrie_diag_avt_nais",
      "pf_fratrie_muco", "pf_fratrie_decede", "pf_fratrie_mois_deces", "pf_fratrie_an_deces",
      "commentaires_fam"), 
    .after = id_keep) %>% 
  select(-(id_date_creation:sf_raison_muco))

rm(list = c("F4_A0", "F4_A1", "F4_A2"))

```

## Identifier les absents

```{r F4_B0 to F4_B1}

vars_check <- F4_B0 %>%
  select(pf_fratrie_prenom:pf_fratrie_an_deces) %>%
  colnames()

F4_B1 <- F4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    fr_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  relocate(fr_complet, .after = fratrie_date_creation)

rm(list = c("vars_check", "F4_B0"))
```

## Retirer les doublons

```{r F4_B1 to F4_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons_1 <- F4_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat == id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  arrange(id_keep, pf_fratrie_an_nais) 
  

# Garder que les lignes différentes ------------------------------------------------
  
doublons_2 <- doublons_1 %>% 
  filter(fr_complet == 1) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les lignes pareilles
  distinct(
    pick(pf_fratrie_prenom:pf_fratrie_an_deces),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  
  # Trouver ceux qui ont plus d'une ligne pour une meme personne
  group_by(id_keep, pf_fratrie_prenom, pf_fratrie_sexe, pf_frsr_issu) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_sibling = cur_group_id()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Trier parmis ceux qui ont renseigné plus d'une fois une meme relation --------

doublons_3 <- doublons_2 %>%
  group_by(id_sibling) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep, id_sibling) %>% 
  ungroup()

doublons_4 <- doublons_3 %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(pf_fratrie_an_nais)) %>% 
  group_by(id_sibling) %>% 
  filter(fratrie_date_creation == min(fratrie_date_creation)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Réunir les doublons ----------------------------------------------------------
doublons_5 <- doublons_2 %>% 
  
  # Retirer ceux qu'on a modifiés
  filter_out(id_sibling %in% doublons_3$id_sibling) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_4) %>% 
  select(-id_sibling)


# Corriger id_anonymat des doublons --------------------------------------------

doublons_corr <- doublons_5 %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  )

# Joindre les données propres
F4_C0 <- F4_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_1$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, pf_fratrie_an_nais, pf_fratrie_mois_nais)

rm(list = c("doublons_1", "doublons_2", "doublons_3", "doublons_4", "doublons_5",
            "doublons_corr"))


```

## Corriger date module

```{r F4_C0 to F4_C1}

verif <- F4_C0 %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_lignes = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat, fratrie_date_creation) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_dates = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  filter(any(n_lignes != n_dates)) %>% 
  relocate(c("n_lignes", "n_dates"), .after = fratrie_date_creation)

corr <- verif %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(fratrie_date_creation = min(fratrie_date_creation)) %>% 
  select(-n_lignes, -n_dates)

F4_C1 <- F4_C0 %>% 
  filter_out(id_anonymat %in% verif$id_anonymat) %>% 
  bind_rows(corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, pf_fratrie_an_nais, pf_fratrie_mois_nais)
  
rm(list = c("verif", "corr", "F4_B1"))
```

## Vérifier la variable borne 

```{r F4_C1 to F4_D0}

F4_D0 <- left_join(
  F4_C1,
  M4_C2_bornes0 %>% 
    select(id_keep, cp_complet, en_complet, fa_complet, fa_fr_fratrie),
  by = "id_keep"
) %>% 
  relocate(c("cp_complet", "en_complet", "fr_complet", "fa_complet", "fa_fr_fratrie", "pf_fratrie",
             "fratrie_pf_fratrie"), .after = fratrie_date_creation) %>% 
  select(-pf_fratrie, -fratrie_pf_fratrie)

```

## Mettre à jour variable borne

```{r M4_C2_bornes0 to M4_C2_bornes2}

M4_C2_bornes1 <- M4_C2_bornes0 %>% 
  rows_update(
    F4_D0 %>% 
      select(id_keep, fa_fr_fratrie) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    F4_D0 %>% 
      select(id_keep, fr_complet) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(fr_complet, .after = fa_fr_fratrie)

M4_C2_bornes2 <- M4_C2_bornes1 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_fr_fratrie = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_fr_fratrie) ~ fa_fr_fratrie,
      is.na(fa_fr_fratrie) & fa_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(fa_fr_fratrie) & fa_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    fr_complet = replace_when(
      fr_complet,
      is.na(fr_complet) ~ 0
    )
  )


```

```{r export1}
 write_csv(M4_C2_bornes2, "../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_C2_bornes2.csv")

rm(list = c("M4_C2_bornes0", "M4_C2_bornes1", "M4_C2_bornes2"))

```

# NETTOYAGE
```{r}

F4_D1 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_F4_D1.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)
```

## Réordonner et renommer

```{r F4_D1 to F4_D2}

rm_pf_fr <- colnames(select(F4_D1,
                    pf_fratrie_prenom:pf_fratrie_an_deces))

rm_frsr <- colnames(select(F4_D1,
                           pf_frsr_issu:pf_frsr_an_adopte))
  
F4_D2 <- F4_D1 %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = all_of(rm_pf_fr), ~ gsub("pf_fratrie_", "", .x)) %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = all_of(rm_frsr), ~ gsub("pf_frsr_", "", .x)) %>% 
  relocate(id_anonymat, prenom:commentaires_fam) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_an_nais = str_sub(id_date_nais, 1, 4),
    id_mois_nais = str_sub(id_date_nais, 6, 7),
    .after = id_anonymat
  )


```

## Vérifier nb fratrie

```{r}

M4_D1 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_D1_tt.csv",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)
vars_dcl <- M4_D1 %>% 
  select(fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb, fa_sf_fratrie_demi_nb,
         fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>% 
  colnames()

info_frt <- M4_D1 %>% 
  filter(id_anonymat %in% F4_D2$id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(id_anonymat, fa_sf_rang_nais, fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb, fa_sf_fratrie_demi_nb,
         fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>% 
  mutate(
    frt_decl = case_when(
      if_all(.cols = fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb, ~ .x < 0) ~ -9,
      if_all(.cols = fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb, ~ .x >= 0) ~ 
        rowSums(pick(fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb)),
      if_any(.cols = fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb, ~ .x >= 0) ~ 
        rowSums(across(fa_sf_fratrie_bio_nb:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb, ~ if_else(.x >= 0, .x, 0)))
    )
  )

F4_D3 <- F4_D2 %>% 
  left_join(
    info_frt,
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(fa_sf_rang_nais:frt_decl, .after = id_mois_nais) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(an_nais, mois_nais) %>% 
  mutate(
    frt_doc = n(),
    rang_frt = sprintf("fa_frt%02d_", row_number()),
    .after = frt_decl
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(frt_doc), id_anonymat, rang_frt)

```
